newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's bourse ends session 0.25 higher.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's bourse ends session 0.25 higher.

text.p: Tunis stock exchange index on Friday closed up by 0.25 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 440.81 points, up from 439.72 on Thursday.
Total volume was 632,734 dinars against 342,247 dinars.
The compagnie d'Assurances et Reassurances Tuniso-Europeenne was up 1.04 dinar to 35.88 dinars.
Chemical firm Alkimia rose by 0.14 dinar to 42.4 dinars. Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing advanced 0.1 dinar to 30.6 dinars.
Banque du Sud was up 0.1 dinar to 10.32 dinars with 8,736 shares changing hands.
Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats d'Investissement was down 0.22 dinar to 22.08 dinars with the exchange of 2,276 shares.
